description: Undecided on who to vote for in District 42? Discover Stacie McGinn’s real solutions for NC Senate District 42. From creating jobs and driving economic growth to improving public safety, Stacie’s platform offers proven leadership that contrasts sharply with Woodson Bradley’s record. Learn how her common-sense policies are designed to enhance life for families in Charlotte, Matthews, Mint Hill, and all of Mecklenburg County.
